entries.german: König Rupertus erlaubt dem Concz von Rosenberg, (Conrads von Rosenberg, Ritter sel. etwan Vicztums von Amberg Sohn) und Conrad von Rosenberg (gleichfalls eines Conrads von Rosenberg Sohn) in ihrem Dorfe zu Sweyern „vnd in sinem begriffe“ Schultheiss und Schöffen zu setzen und ein Halsgericht, Stock und Galgen daselbst zu haben. C.
entries.english: King Ruprecht permits Kunz von Rosenberg (son of Konrad von Rosenberg, deceased Ritter, formerly Vitztum zu Amberg) and Konrad von Rosenberg (also a son of a Konrad von Rosenberg) to appoint a reeve and aldermen and to have there a high court of justice, stocks, and gallows in their village of Schweigern "and in its jurisdiction," C.

facts.content: received King Ruprecht’s permission jointly with Konrad von Rosenberg to appoint a reeve and aldermen and to hold a high court, stocks, and gallows in Schweigern and its jurisdiction.
was identified as a son of a Konrad von Rosenberg whose identity is not established.
